title: Rebase merge nests the cam-e2e capture/exit block inside `if app.noc_e2e` — PP_CAM_E2E alone hangs silently; both-armed runs exit at frame 91 before the NOC captures
detail: The un-gating edit dropped the brace separating the two drives. PP_CAM_E2E=1 alone: cam injections fire but captures/exit sit behind the false noc_e2e gate — the run hangs forever with zero artifacts. Both armed: the nested cam break at frame 91 exits before the NOC captures at 120/240.
recommended_fix: Make `if app.cam_e2e { ... }` a sibling of the noc block again: close `if app.noc_e2e` after its NOC_E2E_EXIT break, then the cam block at the same indent level, then the loop-closing brace.
